column1: # AccessXI typed transport transitions. One row per boarding: the anchor is where the player stands to board (game frame x, z, y; y down), the landing is where they stand on arrival. The search treats a row as a directed edge from_zone -> to_zone; the player zones into via_zone first (a ship or airship hold) and the leg completes on arrival in to_zone. availability: always | key_item:<exact key item name>. availability may also be unlock:<condition> for a gate the runtime cannot yet prove; such edges are never offered to the search and count only as availability-unknown in the census. Sources: LandSandBoat sql/transport.sql (dock positions, transit zones, 2026-08-21), the AccessXI destination catalogue (Cavernous Maw and Telepoint objects), bg-wiki/ffxiclopedia for availability.
